title: Canonical framed C_SC_NA_1 activation
purpose: Provide a compact, fully framed baseline command seed using the documented ASDU field order and C_SC_NA_1 object-specific qualifier byte.
expected_behavior: A CS104 parser should accept the APDU framing, parse TypeID 45 as a valid single-command ASDU with VSQ=1, CoT=6, CA=1, IOA=1, and one command qualifier byte.
constraints_preserved: APDU start byte is 0x68 and byte 1 gives the exact payload length 0x0e
Four APCI control bytes are present before the ASDU
ASDU field order is type_id, vsq, cause_of_transmission, common_address, information_object_address
VSQ is non-sequence form with count 1
Cause of transmission is encoded as 2 octets
Common address is encoded as 2 octets little-endian
Information object address is encoded as 3 octets little-endian
Single command qualifier byte is present after IOA
issue_safety_notes: Uses a complete, conservative one-object command and avoids any truncated body, oversized VSQ, or exact issue payload collision.
